scenarios.prompt:
Write the release notes for version 3.1.0 of our command-line tool, released on 2026-11-02. These are the commits since 3.0.0:

a1b2c3d feat(export): add --format json to the export command
9f8e7d6 fix: the import command no longer crashes on empty files (#412)
4c5d6e7 ci: run the tests on Node 24
7a8b9c0 refactor(config): split the loader into two modules
0d1e2f3 feat!: rename the --dir option to --root
5b6c7d8 chore(deps): bump yaml from 2.5.0 to 2.6.0
criteria: Lists the rename of --dir to --root under a Breaking changes heading
Puts the Breaking changes section before every other section
The bullet about the rename of --dir to --root tells the user how to migrate
Leaves out the CI change, the refactor and the dependency update
Contains no commit hashes and no issue numbers

scenarios.prompt: We are shipping a patch, version 3.1.1, on 2026-11-05. The only change: the progress bar no longer shows more than 100% when a download resumes. Write the release notes.
criteria: Starts with a heading line that holds the version and the date as 2026-11-05
Lists the change under a heading named Fixed
Has no Breaking changes section and no New section
Describes the fix as what the user no longer sees, not as a change to the code
